caption: The second jumper-cable clamp is touched to a car battery terminal, and a spark jumps at the contact.

sa.check: A car battery with jumper cables; one clamp is already attached.
The second clamp is touched to a battery terminal.
A spark jumps at the contact.
The clamp is a jumper-cable clamp: a sprung jaw on a thick cable.
The spark comes as the clamp meets the terminal, not before.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief flash at the point where the clamp meets the terminal, and is gone; there is no spark while the clamp is held away.
pc.fail: A spark appears while the clamp is still clear of the terminal; or the spark glows on at the contact for the rest of the clip; or sparks keep flashing while the clamp sits seated and untouched; or the spark appears somewhere other than where the clamp touches.

pc.expect: Two clamps on one battery; the clamps, cables and terminals keep their number and stay whole; the spark leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: A third clamp appears or one vanishes; or a cable splits or detaches; or a terminal vanishes; or a glowing dot stays on the terminal after the spark.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall from the contact point toward the engine bay floor and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the battery; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the engine parts for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The clamp is a rigid jaw that grips the post; the cable hangs slack from the clamp.
pc.fail: The clamp bends like rubber around the post; or hangs on the post with its jaws still wide open; or the cable stands rigid in the air or stretches like elastic.

pc.expect: The clamp meets the outside of the terminal and stays outside the battery casing; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: The clamp passes into the battery casing; or the cable passes through the bonnet or an engine part; or the battery changes shape; or a hand passes through the clamp.

pc.expect: The cable colours, the battery's label and the engine bay stay the same.
pc.fail: A cable changes colour; or the battery's label changes; or engine parts change shape or place.
